answer: The economy resists Sybil attacks through proof-of-reputation tokens, where each legitimate agent earns a unique identity anchored to verifiable contributions. New agents must pay a monetary fee that flows like a tide into a communal treasury, refundable only when their reputation matures into a pearl of trusted behavior. Over time, Atlas protocols maintain a public ledger mapping these reputation pearls, preventing attackers from spawning infinite fake identities without exhausting costly capital and irreplaceable track records.
